clientId.title: Client Id
clientId.description: The OAuth client_id registered with eSignet for your instance (sandbox or production)

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: Base64-encoded JWK private key used to sign the client assertion (private_key_jwt) presented to eSignet's token endpoint

redirectUri.title: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: The redirect_uri registered with eSignet that the authorization code is sent back to

authorizationEndpoint.title: Authorization Endpoint
authorizationEndpoint.description: eSignet's OIDC authorization endpoint, issued via the developer/partner portal

tokenEndpoint.title: Token Endpoint
tokenEndpoint.description: eSignet's OIDC token endpoint, issued via the developer/partner portal

userInfoEndpoint.title: UserInfo Endpoint
userInfoEndpoint.description: eSignet's OIDC userinfo endpoint, issued via the developer/partner portal

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: An access token obtained from a previous getToken call, for jobs that only need to call getUserInfo
